verdict.rationale: Reflect's site says note contents are end-to-end encrypted so that "no one else can read them (not even us)". The founder repeats the claim, and a community member credits a security audit. Multi-device use is only implied by the iOS app and the browser extensions; no doc describes the sync service itself. A vendor statement quoted in the community says uploaded files and images are not end-to-end encrypted, a real caveat for sensitive attachments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-device sync, E2EE coverage of attachments, independent technical verification of the encryption design.
